items.question: What power does a mere glance of the eye hold to remove affliction and withering?
premises: Affliction and withering are conditions subject to removal.
A mere glance of the eye functions as the effective means.
The effect of removal occurs immediately.
items.inference: A mere glance of the eye is sufficient to dispel affliction and withering at once.
uncertainties: The subject of nayatu is carried over from the preceding verse and is not explicit in this token set.
items.plain_english: May she at once lead away affliction and withering by the mere glance of her eye.
